name: Pagelever
long_description:
PageLever is the leading analytics platform for measuring your brand’s presence on Facebook.

4 of the top 10 Facebook pages rely on PageLever, as well as brands like YouTube, MTV, and Intel.

In January 2013, PageLever was acquired by Unified Social.
one_liner: Facebook analytics. Acquired by Unified in January 2013.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Founder at Transform.

Transform is modernizing the southeastern United States by building a network of studios that focus on the education and applied uses of artificial intelligence. Each studio is being built near a major university and focusing on problems that align with their strongest programs and regional workforce needs.
